Based on what I found on the operators' own pages, here are the real preschool swim options running in Oakville this fall:

```json
{
  "picks": [
    {
      "name": "Learn to Swim - Parent and Tot / Preschool, Town of Oakville",
      "age_fit": "Preschool levels (Swim for Life program) - children must be the required age for the level by the program start date",
      "source_name": "Town of Oakville"
    },
    {
      "name": "Preschool Swim Lessons, YMCA of Oakville",
      "age_fit": "children between 3 to 5 years old",
      "source_name": "YMCA of Oakville"
    },
    {
      "name": "Preschool Swim Lessons, Goldfish Swim School Oakville",
      "age_fit": "indoor lessons for children ages 4 months through 12 years old, with preschool-stage classes following the infant level",
      "source_name": "Goldfish Swim School Oakville"
    }
  ]
}
```

Notes on what I could and couldn't confirm:
- 
Fall recreation and culture program registration for the Town of Oakville opens Tuesday, August 11 at 7 a.m., with program options available to browse online starting August 4
 — so by now (Aug 25) fall registration is already open, but the actual day/time/price for the Preschool level sits behind their booking-page login, which I couldn't get into to confirm specifics.
- For the YMCA, 
for children between 3 to 5 years old, the YMCA Preschool Swim Lessons program will introduce your baby, toddler, or preschooler to the basics of swimming
, but their page didn't give me a specific fall day/time or price either.
- Goldfish Swim School's Oakville page confirms 
lessons are designed for children ages 4 months through 12 years old, all within an indoor setting
, with 
preschool swim programs focusing on linking movements together more smoothly
 as swimmers progress — but again no fall-specific schedule or price was posted.
